class.name: WorldOrigin
class.brief_description: A floating origin: keeps the player near (0, 0, 0) in a large world.
class.description: Far from (0, 0, 0), single-precision positions step in millimetres and things near the camera shimmer and jitter. WorldOrigin moves the whole world back under the player in whole steps ([member step], a kilometre by default), so everything near them stays near the origin. Call [method follow] with the player's position every frame. Positions on the map, which don't change with a shift, are global positions plus [member offset]: save and send them with [method to_map], and read them back with [method to_global]. Nodes under [member world] move with it; anything that keeps global positions of its own adds the shift when [signal shifted] says. Shaders find a vertex's map position as its world position plus the [code]map_offset[/code] global shader parameter. Shifts are whole metres, so [member offset] is exact in single precision for any world on the scale of a planet. A shift moves everything in the world's [World3D] at once on the renderer and in physics ([method RenderingServer.scenario_shift], [method PhysicsServer3D.space_shift]), rather than node by node. Nodes that don't move with [member world] (outside it, or top-level) are put back where they are.

method.name: follow
method.description: Keeps [param global] (the player, or what the camera follows) near the origin. Past [member calm_distance] from it, measured on the ground, the world shifts when [param calm] is [code]true[/code]; past [member max_distance], it shifts whatever's happening. Pass [code]false[/code] for [param calm] while a shift's moment of work would show (the player moving fast), and [code]true[/code] while it wouldn't (standing still, the screen dark).

method.name: reset
method.description: Puts the world back in the map's own frame, with no offset: for a new world loading.

method.name: shift
method.description: Moves the world, and everything under it, by [param by], rounded to whole metres. [method follow] calls it when it's time.

method.name: to_global
method.description: The global position of a point on the map.

method.name: to_map
method.description: The map position of a global point: what to save or send.

members.member: Metres from the origin, on the ground, past which [method follow] shifts the world at a calm moment. Starts from [code]world_origin/calm_distance[/code].
Metres from the origin past which [method follow] shifts the world whatever's happening. Starts from [code]world_origin/max_distance[/code].
The map position of the global origin: map positions are global ones plus this.
The world shifts by whole multiples of this many metres. Starts from [code]world_origin/step[/code].

The node the world hangs from, moved by each shift. Unless set, the current scene when it's a [Node3D]. Particles simulating in world space under it start afresh with a shift, as Godot can't move them.

signal.name: shifted
signal.description: The world moved by [param by]. Add it to any global positions you keep yourself.
